title: Snowflake previews AI Gateway for Advertising with governed Meta and TikTok connections
subtitle: The gateway sits next to Cortex Agents, uses Model Context Protocol integrations to Meta and TikTok, requires human approval per step, and is built on the Natoma MCP platform acquired in May.
author: AESOP AI Engine
body: Snowflake previewed its AI Gateway for Advertising this week — a governed layer over Model Context Protocol integrations that currently covers Meta and TikTok. The gateway sits next to Snowflake Cortex Agents and combines first-party enterprise context with live platform data such as campaign delivery, catalog health, and diagnostics. Campaign managers approve each step. The product is built on Natoma, the enterprise MCP platform Snowflake acquired in May 2026. PMG is named as an early customer, and the gateway was showcased on October 7 at Advertising Week New York.

The novel part isn't an AI feature inside an ad platform — it's an ad agent that can read across platforms and the warehouse without exposing PII or breaking the Conversions API pipeline. The governance pattern — MCP as the connective tissue, human approval per step — is the one regulated industries have been waiting for. The fact that TikTok's monetization-partnerships team is quoted on an open MCP server is itself a signal about where protocol standardization is heading in a space where every platform has historically guarded its own API.

MCP has moved from specification to wire format across major platforms in six months. Atlassian's rebuilt MCP server now handles 15 million calls a day, Google's new universal Gemini agent calls any MCP server as a tool, Microsoft Dynamics has agentic MCP endpoints, and TikTok and Meta have joined the list. The pattern looks less like a product category and more like plumbing — the per-vendor integration work AI agents used to require is becoming shared infrastructure.

MCP is the first serious attempt at an interoperability standard for AI agents. If you're learning the stack, prioritize understanding what an MCP server exposes, how it is authenticated, and what the agent is allowed to call on your behalf. The companies hiring agent engineers in 2027 will care more about safe tool-use boundaries than about which model is routing the calls — the model will change again next quarter, but the plumbing is what sticks.
